column1: # The locales PeakFlow actually serves - not ISO 639-1 in full.
# A registry of 184 language codes would be a list of languages the product has no
# translations for, and every one of them would be offerable in a dropdown that then
# renders English. So this file holds what is served, and a language arrives here in
# the same commit as its translation files or not at all.
# tag          BCP 47, which is what `<html lang>`, Accept-Language and ICU all take
# direction    ltr or rtl. Needed by every template, so it is data and not a guess
# numbering    the ICU numbering system digits are rendered in: arab = ٠١٢٣, latn = 0123
# endonym      the language's name in itself, because a language picker that says
#              "Arabic" to someone who does not read English has failed at step one
# plurals      the CLDR plural categories the locale uses, so a translator knows how
#              many forms a message needs before writing it
